placing_sentence: Guan (JRSS-B): localizer breaks exchangeability, so alpha-tilde is recalibrated to restore exact MARGINAL coverage (Thm 3.2 + randomized rule); local/conditional coverage asymptotic only (S5.1).
Network sampling: 'conditional exchangeability via invariant selectors' restores exchangeability by design; random-walk case is asymptotic (builds on Chernozhukov time-series arguments).

Hore & Barber: calLCP restores marginal coverage (an instance of full conformal with a modified score); for local coverage 'there are no known distribution-free theoretical results to guarantee this'; randomization CHANGES THE TARGET rather than claiming exact local.

Learned nonconformity score s_theta(x): a richer A(x,.), trained on its own data then frozen -- still pooled calibration. 'Preserves CP's finite-sample guarantees' is legitimate for exactly frozen-floor's reason. Screen false positive.
DS-CP: extends Barber et al. 2023 Thm 2 to data-dependent weights; 'achieves the nominal level 1-alpha UP TO A COVERAGE GAP determined by ... the normalized weights'. Bound-with-gap, stated as such.
Survival under covariate shift: Tibshirani-style weighted p-values with likelihood-ratio tilts; 'this construction ensures marginal coverage'. The known-shift escape.

Leverage-Weighted CP: the weight w(h_i) scales the SCORE (normalized conformal with leverage-based sigma); 'marginal validity for any weight function, as a direct consequence of exchangeability'. Score modification, still pooled. Screen false positive.
GraphLCP: 'guarantees marginal coverage with finite samples while efficiently attaining favorable test conditional coverage' -- conditional is empirical, marginal is the theorem.

Conrad-Moulines-Samsonov: Thm 1 marginal; Thm 3 gives finite-sample LOCAL conditional bounds but only under assumptions P1/A1(S)/A2(S) and n >= n2(h,delta,alpha) -- the smoothness class is assumed, distribution-freeness given up. Exactly the trade smoothing-validity prices.
